_comment: Enforced on BOTH the discovery loop and deterministic replay. The agent must not act outside this.
_risky_note: Matched case-insensitively against a control's visible text/accessible name. 'submit' alone is intentionally NOT here — too many benign buttons say Submit; we match specific irreversible verbs.
_policy_values: block | confirm | flag — how replay treats a risky control when it appears in the step list or on the page
